title.narrative: Tanzania Monitoring, Evaluation, Learning and Adaptation (T-MELA) activity

description.narrative: Provide technical and advisory services to meet the missions monitoring, evaluation, and learning requirements. The technical assistance will improve the design, implementation, and oversight of programs throughout Tanzania through sector, issue, and activity-level assessments. It will further empower local partners to enhance development program planning.
